latest.title: PhishShield AI: Real-Time Cyber Threat Detection System
latest.description: PhishShield AI is a comprehensive full stack cybersecurity product which helps detect any phishing threats along with malicious URLs and SQL injections. Constructed using React and FastAPI, PhishShield AI applies rule-based and pattern recognition algorithms for risk scoring purposes as well as classifying the inputs as being either SAFE, SUSPICIOUS, or PHISHING. Input validations, rate limiting, secure headers, and structured logs add on to the overall security architecture.
